text: {"judgments":[{"claim_index":0,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The Project Overview Document's Key Details section states Total Approved Budget: $2,400,000."},{"claim_index":1,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown, Budget Notes section, states that following a Finance Committee revision in December 2026 the total budget was adjusted to $2,600,000."},{"claim_index":2,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Both inputs ($2,400,000 and $2,600,000) appear in the evidence, and the difference of $200,000 is correct."},{"claim_index":3,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The Team & Governance Document states that budget changes above $50,000 must be approved by the Finance Committee before implementation."},{"claim_index":4,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Absence claim that only says what the documents do not state, and asserts no other project fact beyond the Finance Committee being named as having revised the budget."},{"claim_index":5,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"A pure absence claim that asserts no other facts about the project."}]}
